caption: The drawing features a single object located centrally on a plain, light beige background. The object consists of a cylindrical wooden vessel with a slightly wider base tapering upward, and a tall, vertical wooden stick extending from its top center. The vessel appears to be constructed from two sections, as indicated by a horizontal division around its midpoint. The wood is depicted in shades of light brown with subtle grain lines and small knots that are visible, giving a natural wood texture. There are faint markings or lines suggesting the construction or assembly of the vessel, particularly near the base and the middle seam. The stick is straight and smooth, matching the vessel in color. No other objects or colors are present, and the drawing is simple, focusing exclusively on this wooden implement.
title: Churn
